slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: “江离，你说这黄庭丹我是给你……还是不给你呢？若给你，就怕你把握不住啊。”
说话者是负责管理小月宗杂役弟子的金管事。
名为江离的十四岁少年，极其恭敬且谨慎的站在他面前，等待着金管事后面的话。
他来小月宗，本想碰碰运气，看能不能成为一名小月宗的外门弟子。
奈何天资薄弱，是最低等的五灵根，也就比完全没有灵根，无法修仙的人强上一些。
此等灵根，小月宗自然看不上他。
退而求其次，江离只好成为了一名小月宗偏独峰的杂役弟子。
毕竟杂役弟子也是弟子，这也算进了小月宗不是？
万一哪天走了狗屎运，获得一两种修仙的功法，也不是没有可能。
但他万没想到，刚一进小月宗，金管事就直接塞给了他一本名为《黄庭经》的功法，让他去抄录。
这让他既惊讶又兴奋。
杂役弟子也有功法可以修行，这可是他以前从未听说过的事。
和黄庭经一起的，还有一枚黄庭丹。
这枚黄庭丹本也应该给他，此时金管事却拿着黄庭丹，一副十分为难的样子。
“按理说，这枚黄庭丹也应该给你。只是你刚成为小月宗的杂役弟子，根基尚浅，没有靠山。杂役弟子中的那些老人，可有不少贪心的主。”
“要是黄庭丹在你手上，免不了让那些人心生贪念。到时白白挨一顿揍不说，再被抢了黄庭丹，可不值当。”
江离心中一沉。
金管事话中之语已经说的清楚。
明摆着就是想霸占了他那枚黄庭丹。
看来他想要得到这枚黄庭丹……难了！
修仙宗门，虽说是修仙之所，但同样也是吃人不吐骨头的地方。
对于江离这种杂役弟子来说，除去那些仙人老爷，就属金管事最大。
他没有丝毫可以讨价还价的资格。
若是将金管事得罪，即便不当场发作，也会事后给他穿小鞋。
搞不好，还会想办法整死自己。
沉吟片刻。
虽说心中不舍，但还是只能强行挤出个笑脸道：“金管事所言极是。这黄庭丹在我手中确实是一个烫手山芋。”
一咬牙：“小子……愿意将这枚黄庭丹送于金管事。”
没想到此言一出，金管事顿时把脸拉了下来。
“荒谬！”
“你觉得我像是那种喜欢霸占自家兄弟黄庭丹的人吗？”
“你若觉得我是想贪墨你的黄庭丹，你现在拿去便是。”
金管事一甩衣袖，说的义正言辞。
content_en:
"Jiang Li, do you think I will give this Huang Ting Dan to you... or not? If I give it to you, I'm afraid you won't be able to grasp it."
The speaker is Manager Jin who is responsible for managing the miscellaneous disciples of Xiaoyue Sect.
A fourteen-year-old boy named Jiang Li stood in front of him with great respect and caution, waiting for Manager Jin's next words.
He came to Xiaoyue Sect, wanting to try his luck and see if he could become an outer disciple of Xiaoyue Sect.
However, those with weak talents have the lowest level of the five spiritual roots, which is better than those who have no spiritual roots at all and cannot cultivate immortality.
With such spiritual roots, Xiao Yuezong naturally looked down upon him.
Deciding to settle for the next best thing, Jiang Li had no choice but to become a handyman disciple of Xiaoyue Sect's Piandu Peak.
After all, the handyman disciples are also disciples, so this counts as joining the Xiaoyue Sect, right?
If you get really lucky one day, it's not impossible to acquire one or two immortal skills.
But he never expected that as soon as he entered Xiaoyue Sect, Manager Jin directly handed him a book of exercises called "Huang Ting Sutra" and asked him to copy it.
This surprised and excited him.
The handyman disciples also had skills to practice, which was something he had never heard of before.
Along with Huang Tingjing, there is also a Huang Tingdan.
This Huang Ting Dan should have been given to him, but at this time, Manager Jin was holding the Huang Ting Dan, looking very embarrassed.
"It stands to reason that this Huangting Pill should be given to you. It's just that you have just become a handyman disciple of Xiaoyue Sect, and your foundation is still shallow and you have no backer. There are many greedy masters among the old people among the handyman disciples."
"If Huang Ting Dan is in your hands, it will inevitably make those people greedy. Not to mention getting beaten in vain, and being robbed of Huang Ting Dan is not worth it."
Jiang Li's heart sank.
Manager Jin's words have been clearly stated.
It was obvious that he wanted to occupy his Huang Ting Dan.
It seems that he wants to get this Huang Ting Dan... it's difficult!
Although the Immortal Cultivation Sect is a place for cultivating immortals, it is also a place that eats people without spitting out their bones.
For a handyman disciple like Jiang Li, apart from those immortal masters, the one with the most important job is Metal.
He has no bargaining power whatsoever.
If Manager Jiang Jin is offended, even if he doesn't get angry on the spot, he will be given some shoes afterwards.
If it doesn't work well, he might even think of ways to kill himself.
Think for a moment.
Although he felt reluctant to give up, he could only force out a smile and said: "What Manager Jin said is absolutely true. This Huang Ting Dan is indeed a hot potato in my hands."
Gritting his teeth: "Boy... I am willing to give this Huang Ting Dan to Manager Jin."
Unexpectedly, as soon as these words came out, Manager Jin immediately pulled his face down.
"Absurd!"
"Do you think I'm the kind of person who likes to dominate my brother Huang Tingdan?"
"If you think I want to covet your Huang Ting Dan, just take it now."
Manager Jin flicked his sleeves and spoke righteously.
